name: Strong agreement
description: Closely matches the principal sound sources, events and characteristics in the references.

name: Mostly aligned
description: Agrees with the main content of the references, with minor differences in wording or emphasis.

name: Mostly aligned with additional details
description: The main description agrees, but the caption adds acoustic details absent from the references.

name: Partially aligned with missing details
description: Captures some referenced content but omits important sound sources, events or characteristics.

name: Partially aligned with additional details
description: Captures some referenced content but introduces sources, events or descriptions not in the references.

name: Weak agreement or sound-source/event mismatch
description: Differs substantially from the references or appears to describe a different source or event.
